dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 01, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Monday MLB Recap: Home Runs Galore and Pitching Dominance**

A day filled with offense and pitching prowess, as several home runs were hit across the league. Dansby Swanson led the way in the Chicago Cubs' 23-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, hitting three home runs and driving in eight runs. Alec Bohm also homered twice for the Philadelphia Phillies in their 10-6 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Ozzie Albies hit a solo shot for the Atlanta Braves in their 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals. Meanwhile, Cedric Mullins and Kody Clemens each hit a home run in their respective teams' wins, as the Tampa Bay Rays defeated the Kansas City Royals 4-0 and the Minnesota Twins topped the Houston Astros 8-3.

On the pitching side, Noah Schultz threw 4.1 innings, striking out seven and allowing three earned runs for the Baltimore Orioles in their 6-1 win over the Chicago White Sox. Joey Cantillo pitched 5.0 innings, fanning four and surrendering two earned runs for the Cleveland Guardians in their 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers. Shane McClanahan went six scoreless innings, striking out four for the Tampa Bay Rays.
